literal_meaning: দ্বিতীয়বার বিবাহিত পুরুষের জীবিত প্রথম স্ত্রী
figurative_meaning_en: The living first wife of a man who has married a second time
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অধিবিন্না এখনও জীবিত আছে, তাই দ্বিতীয় স্ত্রীর সঙ্গে সম্পর্ক জটিল হয়ে উঠেছে।
পুরনো দিনে অধিবিন্নার অবস্থা খুব কষ্টকর ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: His adhivinna is still alive, making the relationship with the second wife complicated.
In old times, the condition of the adhivinna was very difficult.
history: This term originates from historical Hindu marriage practices in Bengal where polygamy was allowed under certain conditions, particularly in upper-caste families before modern legal reforms.
note: This is more of a specialized term than a figurative idiom, rooted in traditional Bengali social norms.
